Customize for your specific brain type! Take the quiz to select the channel, select background images, session start sound and timer length...and BOOM get productive...

Our mission is to help you focus. We're the pioneers in the focus music space. We started Focus@Will in 2011, our founder is a platinum selling song writer with over 30 years in the music industry, who knows a lot about music entertainment, but we wanted to try something radically new. So we built a team; hand selected neuroscientists, musicians, and engineers to produce a unique new product. Music for productivity.

Over the last 10 years we've helped over 2,000,000 people focus by tailoring brain music specifically to their brain type. Our proprietary AI engine is linked with the world's largest brain database, and our music is created by musicians specifically for productivity.

The music you find on Focus@Will cannot be found anywhere else; we remaster, re-edit, and re-produce each track to remove all distracting elements so you can stay productive and focused

What’s the value -- to your job, your success, your self-image -- of just one intensely-focused session where you filter out distractions and produce more work in two hours than you typically do in a day? Now, what if you multiplied that value over the course of a month, a year? That's what Focus@Will helps you achieve.

This app gives you a 7-day full-feature free trial. Just install and run. Then do your best work session ever. On-demand.

How do I know if this will work for me? Our in-app assessment agent uses data from the biggest brain database in the world combined with our own data of over 10 years of music brain research to prescribe which specific music type and energy level will work best for you. If it doesn't, no worries we offer a full 30 day money back guarantee!

Can I listen offline? Yes! We have offline mode.

Can I track my productivity? Yes! We have a built in productivity tracker.

Is there a focus timer? Yes! We encourage you to use the focus timer as a pomodoro timer, create work sessions and break times countless times a day.

Can I change the session start/end sound? Yes! Or turn them off completely.

Our subscribers are entrepreneurs, freelancers, writers, students, and include people that work in large corporations like; Google, Tesla, Apple, SpaceX and Microsoft.

Who we are: We're an independent neuroscience company based in Los Angeles, California. Our mission is to empower you to be the best version of yourself; have a healthy work/life balance; and create fulfillment and happiness in your life.

What sets us apart: We love Calm, Headspace, Brain.fm, Endel and the rest, but we offer an individualized music-for-work solution based on our connection to the biggest brain database in the world. Every audio mix is different for every user, and all the sounds and music we deliver are unique to our system.

Our system manages the ratio between your endogenous attention (ie the task you are focusing on) and your exogenous attention (ie your reptile brain looking for potentially dangerous 'fight or flight' external stimuli). Every human is different, the type of music that helps calm this response is highly individual. (Fun fact: the more easily distracted you are, the more energy you need to help you focus. Now you'll know why our ADHD channel is the way it is!)

Spotify, Apple Music, Pandora, etc., we're big fans - but not when we're trying to be productive! The focus playlists found in these streaming services is usually someone's vague idea of what worked for them. When you want to get stuff done Focus@Will is the only option that was created specifically for productivity needs.

results.description:
FocusPomo is a Pomodoro-based time management app with a minimal and beautiful design, powerful features, and a rewarding sense of progress.

Our mission is to improve and protect your attention. That’s why we don’t simply pile on features, and we don’t use addictive game-like rewards. FocusPomo is built to help you focus on one thing at a time.

## When you may need FocusPomo

1. You work hard, but still don’t feel real progress
2. Your study or work efficiency feels low
3. You get distracted easily and want to reduce procrastination
4. Important things keep getting delayed
5. You want to become more disciplined
6. You want different parts of your life to gradually get better
7. You have many things you want to do, but keep making slow progress

## FocusPomo Core Features

1. Real-time sync across all platforms. Sync through iCloud across Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, so your focus data always stays up to date.

2. A simple and easy-to-use focus timer. No flashy design, no complicated distractions. Everything is designed for a better focus experience.

3. Cute little tomatoes that make focus feel rewarding. Every completed Pomodoro gives you a cute little tomato. Your tomatoes accumulate each week, making effort more visible without turning focus into a distracting game. Tomatoes also support motion response and haptic feedback (motion response is currently supported on iOS only).

4. Powerful focus statistics. View focus trends, Pomodoro insights, and detailed data across different tasks and time ranges.

5. Calendar timeline. Reflection helps you improve. View your focus time distribution by one day, two-day comparison, or one week.

6. Optimized for iPad and Mac large screens. View more useful information and enjoy a focus experience designed for larger screens.

7. Mac support. View timer status, focus task, and today’s focus data from the menu bar. Start, pause, or end focus sessions without opening the app.

8. Apple Watch App that works independently. No iPhone needed. Start a timer, create or edit focus tasks, and manage focus directly on Apple Watch.

## FocusPomo Design Philosophy

1. Focus. We don’t build an all-in-one product. We focus on time management and help make your effort truly pay off.

2. Simplicity. Simplicity is not the goal. It is the result. Every feature and detail is carefully researched, considered, and refined.

3. Warmth. FocusPomo hopes to become a small quiet space for you, staying with you through your effort, focus, and growth.

## More Features

* App blacklist to block distracting apps
* Home Screen widgets, Lock Screen widgets, and interactive widgets
* Live Activities and Dynamic Island
* Landscape StandBy mode for focus sessions
* Custom countdown timer
* Stopwatch mode with pause support
* Different focus tags can have different focus durations
* Apple Health sync
* Manually add focus time
* Custom Pomodoro cycles, long breaks, and short breaks
* Custom focus tags
* Extend focus sessions
* Alarm reminders
* Focus trends by task and time range
* Calendar timeline by 1 day, 2 days, or 1 week
* Optimized for iPad and Mac large screens
* The current Lifetime plan includes all future updates, including Watch and Mac
* And many more features

## 6000+ reviews from users around the world, 59000+ five-star ratings

“No bloat, no unnecessary features fighting for attention — just clean timers that keep me locked in.”

“Collecting Pomodoros makes it a fun and unique experience.”

“Simple but deep”

“Helps me stay on track working from home.”

“One of the very few apps I’ve kept in my phone… Definitely worth the penny.”

results.description:
Focus Keeper is the ultimate focus timer and Pomodoro timer designed to help you boost productivity and fight against procrastination. Whether you're a student preparing for an exam, managing ADHD, or simply trying to stay focused, this app is here to make your time management easier. By leveraging the original Pomodoro method, Focus Keeper helps you break down your tasks into manageable intervals and balance work with breaks, so you can stay on track without burning out.

With a built-in study tracker, customizable settings, and an intuitive design, Focus Keeper is ideal for those who need a reliable exam timer or just want to track their progress efficiently.

Focus Keeper: Pomodoro Timer, Exam Timer, ADHD
Pomodoro – Stay true to the original technique with 25-minute sessions followed by short breaks to keep your mind sharp.

Customizable Focus Timer – Adjust the length of your sessions, short breaks, and long breaks to suit your workflow.

Exam Timer & Study Timer – Ideal for students and professionals, the product acts as a perfect exam timer to help you easily manage study sessions.

ADHD Friendly – Tailored for those with ADHD, the app’s structured technique helps improve concentration and task completion.

Time Tracker – Track your productivity over time with insightful charts and fight against ADHD and procrastination.

Simple Interface – With a clean and intuitive design, it's easy to set up your focus timer and start working on your tasks immediately.

How Its Works?
Set Your Focus Timer & Study Timer– Choose a task and set the clock for 25 minutes.
Work Until the Rings – Stay focused on your task until the Pomodoro rings.
Take a Short Break – Enjoy a 5-minute break after each session to refresh your mind.
Long Breaks – After completing 4 focus sessions, take a longer break of 20-30 minutes to recharge.
The app automatically starts the next session, so you can stay productive without interruptions.

Who Can Benefit?
Whether you're a student needing a reliable study timer for exams, a professional managing multiple tasks, or someone who struggles with ADHD, the concentration app is the perfect tool. The app provides a structured routine, making it easier to avoid distractions and procrastination. Its built-in time tracker and customizable settings ensure that you can stay productive in any environment, from the office to the study room.

Why ?
Unlike other apps, Focus Keeper offers an original Pomodoro experience while giving you full control over how you manage your focus sessions. Whether you're using it as an exam timer, a study timer, or to manage ADHD, its versatile features and easy-to-use interface make it stand out. Track your productivity over time, customize your features, and use it as a stopwatch for specific tasks – all while avoiding procrastination and staying on task.
